summary.background: For the Byeolmicheon catchment ( $1.17km^2$ ) located in the upstream of Gyeongancheon watershed and total 18 storm events measured during 3 years (2011-2013), the hourly SWAT was calibrated and validated using the Green and Ampt (G&A) infiltration equation.
